definitions: To configure a network router or firewall to redirect incoming network traffic from a specific port to a particular device or service within a private network.
To establish a rule that allows external devices to access services on a local network device through a specified port.
examples: You need to set port forward on your router to access the game server.
The administrator will set port forward for the new web server.
I will set port forward so my friend can connect to my Minecraft world.
pastTenses: set port forwarded, set port forwarded
